description: Defines the AnonymousTokensRsaBssaClient class for generating and processing RSA blind signatures within the anonymous tokens protocol, including methods for creating requests, processing responses, and verifying tokens.

classes.name: AnonymousTokensRsaBssaClient
classes.description: A class for generating RSA blind signatures, creating signing requests, processing responses, and verifying tokens in the anonymous tokens protocol.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an instance of the client with a specified RSA public key.

methods.name: CreateRequest
methods.description: Generates a blind signature request from input messages and metadata.

methods.name: ProcessResponse
methods.description: Processes the server's signature response to obtain unblinded tokens.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Verifies the validity of an anonymous token against the public key and input message.
